get.summary:
Gets the summary metrics of a space in the account identified by the given ID.
Metrics are aggregated per collection and may be paginated (a space can have many collections).
Required permissions:
- read:serverless_spaces

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the account (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

parameters.name: spaceId
parameters.description:
The identifier for the space (in GUID format).
This space should be part of the provided account.
This is a required field.

parameters.name: collectionName
parameters.description: Exact collection name. Returns metrics for that collection only.

parameters.name: collectionNameContains
parameters.description:
Case-insensitive substring matched against collection names.
Returns metrics for every collection whose name contains this value.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description:
Maximum number of collection metrics to return.
If not specified, all matching items are returned.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description:
A page token, received from a previous call.
Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.
When paginating, all other parameters provided to the request must match
the call that provided the page token.

get.summary:
Gets the detailed usage metrics (as timeseries) of a space in the account identified by the given ID.
Metrics are aggregated per collection and may be paginated (a space can have many collections).
Required permissions:
- read:serverless_spaces

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the account (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

parameters.name: spaceId
parameters.description:
The identifier for the space (in GUID format).
This space should be part of the provided account.
This is a required field.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
Optional start time for the metrics query.
If omitted, defaults to 1 hour ago.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description:
Optional end time for the metrics query.
If omitted, defaults to current time.

parameters.name: aggregator
parameters.description:
Aggregation function to apply to the time series data.
If omitted, defaults to SUM.

 - AGGREGATOR_UNSPECIFIED: Unspecified aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_SUM: SUM aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_AVG: AVG aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_MAX: MAX aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_MIN: MIN aggregation function.

parameters.name: collectionName
parameters.description: Exact collection name. Returns metrics for that collection only.

parameters.name: collectionNameContains
parameters.description:
Case-insensitive substring matched against collection names.
Returns metrics for every collection whose name contains this value.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description:
Maximum number of collection metrics to return.
If not specified, all matching items are returned.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description:
A page token, received from a previous call.
Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.
When paginating, all other parameters provided to the request must match
the call that provided the page token.

v1Aggregator.description:
Aggregator defines how metrics should be aggregated over time.

 - AGGREGATOR_UNSPECIFIED: Unspecified aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_SUM: SUM aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_AVG: AVG aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_MAX: MAX aggregation function.
 - AGGREGATOR_MIN: MIN aggregation function.

items.description: List of metrics aggregated per collection in the space.

totalSize.description:
The total number of items available (useful in relation with pagination).
This field is fill out when pagination is used (aka in the request `page_size` was provided).

nextPageToken.description:
A token that can be sent as `page_token` to retrieve the next page.
If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages.

v1GetSpaceSummaryMetricsResponse.description: GetSpaceSummaryMetricsResponse is the response from the GetSpaceSummaryMetrics function.

v1IntervalAverage.description: IntervalAverage represents the average value of a metric over a specific time interval.

searchRequests.description: Overview of search request rates for the collection.

writeRequests.description: Overview of write (CRUD) request rates for the collection.

searchLatency.description: Overview of search latency for the collection.

usedStorageBytes.description:
Current used (active) storage size of the collection, in bytes.
This is actual usage. Platform or customer storage ceilings are exposed
via space/collection quotas and are not part of this response.
